scope: Validate and reproduce the legacy supervised smart-meter Random Forest and logistic-regression baselines from a copied local CSV.
safety_boundaries: No Docker command, container operation, HTTP request, application endpoint, Kafka action, persistent volume, or secret was used.
The repository dataset, source code, installed model artefacts, and historical evidence were read only.
All generated models, figures, analysis files, and Matplotlib cache are under this isolated evidence directory.

executor.reason_for_executor: The bundled document-analysis Python runtime did not include scikit-learn. The pre-existing repository virtual environment contained the pinned project ML dependencies; no packages were installed or changed.

commands.purpose: Schema, label, split, fingerprint-overlap, and static feature-contract validation of the copied CSV.
Offline reproduction of the current supervised baseline in an isolated output directory.
Compare the new metrics with the historical evidence after reproduction.

non_executed.reason: Its labelled input and controlled-artifact directories were access-restricted. The task forbade bypassing access restrictions and did not authorize using a substitute dataset.
The task explicitly prohibited invoking endpoints.
